_comment: HAND QUOTES read 2026-10-07 (Josh, CEO session) from the PUBLIC Pirate Ship rate calculator pirateship.com/rates (no login, no API, no new credential), origin 26651 Summersville WV, residential, 15 corners x 4 boxes = 60 lookups. Each cell is the LEAST-COST allowlisted ground RAW CARRIER QUOTE (UPS Ground 03 / UPS Ground Saver 93 / USPS Ground Advantage) at the zone's WORST corner for that box at the box's median packed billable weight (small 7 lb [median packed 6.5 lb billed up], large 14 lb, p24x10x4 12 lb, p24x10x6 22 lb). NO packaging, NO buffer, NO handling — rate_check applies ceil() and the app adds the flat $5 S&H once per order. Calibration: at 7 lb the page's UPS Ground price matched 7 shipped small-box labels to the cent (KY 8.79, OH 8.29, NY 9.84, SC 9.84, PA/NY 11.15, ME 19.38), so the page is a faithful quote source. CAVEAT (Josh): large + both potted weights are old full-capacity values with no shipped-box data yet — treat those 12 cells as UNVERIFIED until real packed weights exist. Zones 2-4 large/p4/p6 quote identically to zone_1 (same UPS zone from Summersville); the published zone_2-4 split is not supported by these quotes but is left intact (never undercharge). zone_5 small worst corner is downeast ME Mariaville 04605 (Saver 16.89); the real S00232 label there cost 19.38 because UPS Ground was bought, not least-cost Saver (Josh finding #4 — a service choice, not a bug).
